templates.title: Introducing how Plan with Care works with Solicitors
templates.subject: Introducing how Plan with Care works with Solicitors
templates.body:
XXX perhaps we can have a call to understand each other's work better and see if there are any opportunities to support each other.

To give you a bit more info, Thrive Homecare is part of Plan with Care, a quality-of-life focused care and wellbeing service for vulnerable and older people. We work with solicitors to support vulnerable clients by providing health and welfare advice and services. We work with a number of the private clients teams in East Kent and London, Whithead Monkton, Furley Page, Brachers, Warners, Girlings to name a few.

Our services include fully managed care at home, wellbeing support, liaison with health and social care professionals, fixed-cost mental capacity assessments, COP3 assessments. We tailor plans that reduce solicitors' nonchargeable administrative burden while enhancing the support you offer clients. More info here For Solicitors | Plan with Care

If you'd like to chat when would be good for you?

Kind regards,
Chris

templates.title: Referral from Lottie -- Introducing Thrive Homecare
templates.subject: Referral from Lottie -- Introducing Thrive Homecare
templates.body:
Dear [Name],

Thank you for getting in touch with us through Lottie -- it's lovely to hear from you. I understand you're exploring care and support options for your relative, and I'd be very happy to help.

At Thrive Homecare, we do things a little differently. Our approach is relationship-centred, and we specialise in wellbeing as much as practical support. That means we focus not just on what's needed day-to-day, but also on what brings comfort, purpose and joy. Every person we support has a dedicated Health & Wellbeing Associate and a long-term Wellbeing Specialist, helping to build meaningful relationships and truly personalised care.

We're proud of our team and our attention to the small details that really make a difference. Whether it's companionship, help at home, support with physical needs or simply someone to bring a little calm and reassurance, we tailor everything around what matters most to the person you love.

If you'd like to have a chat, I'd be happy to learn more about what you're looking for and answer any questions. We can also arrange a free, no-obligation home visit if that would be helpful.

In the meantime, I have attached a pdf brochure. Looking forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,

[Your Name or Michalina]
Michalina Grzesko

Health & Wellbeing Community Lead
Thrive Homecare

01227 935977 | hello@thrivehomecare.co.uk
www.thrivehomecare.co.uk

templates.title: Solicitors — meeting follow-up
templates.subject: Follow-up from our meeting
templates.body:
Hi [Name],

It was very good to meet you.

PLAN WITH CARE
Plan with Care is a health and wellbeing consultancy working alongside professional attorneys and deputies to maximise the quality of life for vulnerable adults.
https://www.planwithcare.co.uk/solicitors

We offer three main services:

1. Wellbeing Assurance Plans — for lifetime clients, giving you clear oversight of health and welfare with minimal call on your time.
https://www.planwithcare.co.uk/solicitors/wellbeing-assurance

2. Mental Capacity Assessments — quick turnaround, high-quality reports at low cost.
https://www.planwithcare.co.uk/mental-capacity

3. Wellbeing Companionship — from a few hours a week through to live-in care, all focused on living well. We also support people living in care homes to have a better quality of life.
https://www.planwithcare.co.uk/wellbeing-companions
https://www.planwithcare.co.uk/carehome

THRIVE HOMECARE
Thrive Homecare provides companionship and live-in care across Kent and the South East. Our visiting care service operates within 10 miles of Ashford, Canterbury and Whitstable.
https://www.thrivehomecare.co.uk/

We also offer an advice and support service for vulnerable clients.
https://www.thrivehomecare.co.uk/services/wellbeing-subscription

How we can help:

• For anyone who is lonely, isolated or not having a good quality of life, we recommend companionship.
• For anyone who is at risk but currently managing, or who you are concerned about but who does not have the funds for companionship, we recommend Wellbeing Assurance.
• For anyone currently receiving care at home, we can provide companionship alongside their existing care across the South East, and/or replacement care in the East Kent area covered by Thrive.

Suggested next step: for any Mental Capacity Assessments you require, please contact Peter at peter@planwithcare.co.uk or 01233 534033.

If there are any clients whose quality of life you think we might be able to improve, please let me know.

We will send over some flyers for you to give to clients who may benefit from our wellbeing advice to help them continue living well in their own home.

Any questions, please let me know.

All best wishes,
